title: Paprika chicken and roast pepper bulgur

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole ingredient or a plain staple, with no jars, stock pots or packet mixes.

supermarket.reason: Chicken thighs, peppers, bulgur, Greek yoghurt and the rest are everyday items at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: Needs only a roasting tray, a bowl, a grater and a kettle, using simple tray-roasting and soaking.

works.reason: Six boneless thighs at 220°C for 30 minutes cook through, and 200g bulgur soaked in 400ml boiling water gives enough grain for four with the roast veg.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers slicing four peppers and two onions, grating garlic and chopping parsley, and the 30-minute roast matches the cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water; 'paprika' in step one clearly means the listed smoked paprika.

seasonal_feel.reason: Roast peppers suit late July, and with the bulgur and tray juices they make up the bulk of this warm summer salad.

plain_voice.reason: Short, clear British-English steps, with no restaurant jargon or health preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Chicken, plenty of roast veg, wholegrain bulgur and yoghurt make a filling, balanced lunch a family would happily eat again.
